problem.unknownField: “{{field}}” is not a field that can be filtered.
problem.blankValue: One of the {{field}} values is empty.
problem.oneValueOnly: This condition takes one value. Use “is any of” for several.
problem.fieldTwice: {{field}} can only be used once — Q-Agent sends it as a single filter.
problem.anyNeedsOneField: “Any condition” only works within one field, because Q-Agent combines different filters with AND. Use “is any of” to match several values of the same field.

empty.title: No tickets found
empty.body: Try a different filter or sync tickets from your provider.

confirmRemove.title: Remove ticket?
confirmRemove.message: Remove {{id}} from Q-Agent? This only deletes it locally — the work item in your provider is untouched, and a re-sync restores it.

confirmRemoveBulk.message_one: Remove {{count}} selected ticket from Q-Agent? This only deletes them locally — the work items in your provider are untouched, and a re-sync restores them.
confirmRemoveBulk.message_other: Remove {{count}} selected tickets from Q-Agent? This only deletes them locally — the work items in your provider are untouched, and a re-sync restores them.

detail.notFoundBody: This ticket may have been removed or hasn't been synced yet.
